# netbox_module_type (Resource)

Manages a NetBox module type (`/api/dcim/module-types/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_module_type" "example" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.example.id
  model = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the Manufacturer (`netbox_manufacturer`).
- `model` (String) Model.

### Optional

- `airflow` (String) Airflow. Valid values: `front-to-rear`, `rear-to-front`, `left-to-right`, `right-to-left`, `side-to-rear`, `passive`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `attributes` (String) Attributes as a JSON document (`jsonencode({...})`).
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `cooling_method` (String) Cooling Method. Valid values: `air`, `liquid`, `hybrid`, `immersion`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `end_of_life` (String) The date after which this module type is no longer supported by the manufacturer.
- `module_bay_type_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Module Bay Type (`netbox_module_bay_type`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `part_number` (String) Discrete part number (optional). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `profile_id` (Number) ID of the Module Type Profile (`netbox_module_type_profile`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `weight` (Number) Weight.
- `weight_unit` (String) Weight Unit. Valid values: `kg`, `g`, `lb`, `oz`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_module_type can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_module_type.example 123
```
